metadata.question: Does the urban area extent in Jakarta (centered at 6.2°S, 106.8°E) increase between 1989 and 2004?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 SR: LT05 (1989, 2004), with fallbacks to LT04 (for 1989) and LE07 (for 2004).
- Date windows: prefer exact year; if empty, widen to ±1 year.
- AOI: Point at (106.8E, -6.2N) buffered 50 km to cover Jakarta metro.

2. Masking strategy.
- Mask clouds, cloud shadow, dilated clouds, snow via QA_PIXEL bits for L2 collections.
- Build median composites, compute indices.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size 0 after fallbacks: C1.
- If valid pixels after masking = 0: C2.
- If any computed value is null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare built-up area (NDBI>0.1 and NDVI<0.6) in km²; increase -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfoAsync = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Point([106.8, -6.2]).buffer(50000); // 50 km

  function maskScaleL2SR(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
    const mask = dilated.or(cloud).or(shadow).or(snow).not();
    const sr = img
      .select(['SR_B1', 'SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B7'])
      .multiply(0.0000275)
      .add(-0.2)
      .updateMask(mask);
    return sr;
  }

  function trialsForYear(year) {
    const y = year;
    const trials = [
      { id: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LT05', start: `${y}-01-01`, end: `${y}-12-31` },
      { id: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LT05±1y', start: `${y - 1}-01-01`, end: `${y + 1}-12-31` }
    ];
    if (y <= 1993) {
      trials.push({ id: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LT04', start: `${y}-01-01`, end: `${y}-12-31` });
      trials.push({ id: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LT04±1y', start: `${y - 1}-01-01`, end: `${y + 1}-12-31` });
    } else {
      trials.push({ id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LE07', start: `${y}-01-01`, end: `${y}-12-31` });
      trials.push({ id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', label: 'LE07±1y', start: `${y - 1}-01-01`, end: `${y + 1}-12-31` });
    }
    return trials;
  }

  async function getBestCollection(year) {
    const trials = trialsForYear(year);
    for (let t of trials) {
      try {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(t.id)
          .filterDate(t.start, t.end)
          .filterBounds(aoi);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          return { collection: col, label: t.label, dataset: t.id, start: t.start, end: t.end, size: size };
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next trial
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function processYear(year) {
    const best = await getBestCollection(year);
    if (!best) {
      console.log(`${year} Images: 0`);
      return { code: 'C1' };
    }
    const srCol = best.collection.map(maskScaleL2SR);
    const median = srCol.median().clip(aoi);

    const nir = median.select('SR_B4');
    const red = median.select('SR_B3');
    const swir1 = median.select('SR_B5');

    const ndbi = swir1.subtract(nir).divide(swir1.add(nir)).rename('NDBI').updateMask(swir1.add(nir).gt(0));
    const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI').updateMask(nir.add(red).gt(0));

    const built = ndbi.gt(0.1).and(ndvi.lt(0.6));

    const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('one');

    const validCount = ndbi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('NDBI');

    const builtArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).updateMask(built).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('area');

    const totalPix = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(totalCount));
    const validPix = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validCount));
    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      console.log(`${year} Source: ${best.label} ${best.start}..${best.end}, Images: ${best.size}`);
      console.log(`${year} Valid px: 0 / ${totalPix} (valid%: 0.0, cloud%: 100.0)`);
      return { code: 'C2' };
    }
    const areaKm2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(builtArea));
    if (areaKm2 === null || isNaN(areaKm2)) {
      console.log(`${year} Source: ${best.label} ${best.start}..${best.end}, Images: ${best.size}`);
      console.log(`${year} Calculation failed (area null/NaN).`);
      return { code: 'C3' };
    }

    const validPct = (validPix / totalPix) * 100.0;
    const cloudPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - validPct));
    console.log(`${year} Source: ${best.label} ${best.start}..${best.end}, Images: ${best.size}`);
    console.log(`${year} Valid px (1km): ${validPix} / ${totalPix} (valid%: ${validPct.toFixed(1)}%, cloud%: ${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`${year} Urban area (km²): ${areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);

    return { code: 'OK', areaKm2: areaKm2 };
  }

  try {
    const res1989 = await processYear(1989);
    if (res1989.code !== 'OK') { console.log(res1989.code); return; }

    const res2004 = await processYear(2004);
    if (res2004.code !== 'OK') { console.log(res2004.code); return; }

    const a1 = res1989.areaKm2;
    const a2 = res2004.areaKm2;
    const delta = a2 - a1;
    const rel = (delta / Math.max(1e-6, a1)) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Change 1989→2004: ${delta.toFixed(1)} km² (${rel.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    // Decision: "Yes" if 2004 > 1989 by at least 5% (robust to noise)
    const increased = a2 > a1 * 1.05;
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
